state.product: pi-vida: personal per-language agent harness. Direction: personal daily driver; skills/packs layer shared (first outside consumer imminent). Jev 001 confirmed herdr integration as an invest zone (1.91).
state.owner_context: Owner uses herdr pane-native team mode daily and reports NO pain — the goal is improving the support, not fixing something broken.
state.current_inv_herdr_surface: libexec/pi-vida-launch start_herdr_team: inside HERDR_ENV team mode splits one herdr pane per member and starts pi-vida <vida> solo with PI_VIDA_WORKER (reduced member base: damage-control + capabilities + team-member, --no-skills, no boot-config/clarify-gate/status-line). dispatch_agent prompts via herdr agent prompt <member> --wait and reads via herdr agent read --source recent-unwrapped, ONLY for launcher-started members (PI_HERDR_MEMBERS). Dispatch waits on a 15-minute wall clock (PI_CHILD_TIMEOUT_MS); a dead member pane hangs until that timeout. doctor only warns if the herdr binary is missing. The herdr skill no-ops when HERDR_ENV is unset.

candidates.member_recovery: Detect a dead/unresponsive member pane and respawn it (new herdr pane + agent start) instead of hanging until the 15-minute wall clock; fail fast with a clear error when respawn is impossible.
candidates.team_status_observability: A status view (pi-vida team status or doctor subcheck) listing PI_HERDR_MEMBERS panes: alive/dead, current task, last activity — via herdr agent read.
candidates.doctor_herdr_depth: Deepen doctor for herdr: verify server reachability and version compatibility, and flag HERDR_ENV set but herdr missing/mismatch — beyond today's binary-presence warning.
candidates.per_member_model_override: Confirm and extend merged per-role model/thinking overrides (profile defaults under overlay, keyed on agent name) into herdr member panes started by the launcher, so planner/builder/reviewer panes get their role models.
candidates.dispatch_ergonomics: Better dispatch ergonomics: per-call timeouts, partial reads while a member works, and cancel propagation to member panes, instead of one blocking --wait per dispatch.
